versionChanges.changed: Added section-cadence targeting and target-contour control on top of register, repetition, and phrase-diversity fixes.
versionChanges.output: The solos became much more mechanically controlled: clearer cadences, fewer register jumps, better shape. The tradeoff: still sounded too stiff and not idiomatically jazzy enough.
versionChanges.decision: Kept as the musical-shape baseline, not the final sound.

versionChanges.changed: Added controlled weak-beat chromatic approach notes resolving into strong-beat chord tones.
versionChanges.output: The same tunes gained more jazz language and forward motion. This was the first version that clearly sounded better by ear, not just by metrics.
versionChanges.decision: Accepted as the first real jazz-language improvement.

versionChanges.changed: Fine-tuned from v6.3.2 with expanded jazz-vocabulary cache and stronger harmonic safety pressure.
versionChanges.output: The model became more inside and less wrong, but also safer/blander. Harmonic correctness improved at the cost of color and personality.
versionChanges.decision: Documented as the safety-vs-color trap; not promoted over Exp 10.

versionChanges.changed: Applied the accepted Exp 10 bebop-approach vocabulary layer to the v6.6 safety checkpoint outputs.
versionChanges.output: A useful A/B branch: some vocabulary returns, but the underlying checkpoint still does not clearly beat the earlier Exp 10 musical baseline.
versionChanges.decision: Used for comparison; not the new default.

versionChanges.changed: Added timing-aware harmony constraints and inference-control settings; selected iivi_s1p5_np0p25 for the current audition package.
versionChanges.output: The public output set is broader and more harmonically guarded. It is promising, but still labeled as a candidate until the expanded audition is judged by listening.
versionChanges.decision: Current branch to listen to; not called final or best yet.

rendering.current_note: All embedded test/listening outputs now use MIDI-backed full-combo WAV renders: tenor sax lead, comping piano, walking bass, and jazz drum kit. Generated notes are unchanged.
